speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your age and the progressive nature of your fatigue over two months without infection or weight loss, I need to clarify: does the fatigue limit your daily activities, and have you noticed any changes in your urine color, appetite, or easy bruising?

text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue. I also have Appearance of pale skin, Presence of multiple pinpoint, red, nonblanching spots on extremities.

speaker: Doctor
